<!doctype html>
<!--
  INSTALANDING.AI · Thorn Music Controller Page
  slug     thorn-music-controller-page
  prompt   https://instalanding.ai/p/thorn-music-controller-page.txt   (the one-shot brief this file was built from)
  page     https://instalanding.ai/prompt/thorn-music-controller-page
  license  MIT. Fictional product; replace the name, copy, specs and price before shipping.

  MAP
  tokens    :root palette plus three finish token sets under [data-finish=fog|graphite|sand] (shell, face, grip,
            thumb, key and label colours). Fonts Saira (display, labels) and Asap (text) are inlined as woff2 data URIs.
  sections  nav, hero, controls, display, finish, specs, cta, footer
  scripts   one inline <script>, no libraries: builds every device and control from layered DOM (a CSS 3D extrusion:
            stacks of layers at increasing translateZ), a state object mirroring the original state machine
            (power, playing, rec, mode, shuffle, loop, dials, faders, tape), pointer and keyboard input for the dials,
            faders, joystick and tape keys, synthesized click sounds (Web Audio), a render loop, and a cursor-follow
            tilt with a moving specular sheen per scene.
  assets    none: every surface is CSS gradients and layers; fonts are inlined

  ADAPTING
  - Inside a device 1em is one design unit of the artboard (font-size: var(--u)); scale a device by --u only.
  - Depth is faked by stacking layers; more layers give smoother sides but more DOM.
  - State lives on <html> as data-power / data-playing / data-rec / data-mode / data-shuffle / data-loop; CSS reads
    those, so add styles there rather than toggling classes.
  - The finish swatches set data-finish on <html>.
-->
<html lang="en" data-finish="fog" data-power="off" data-playing="0" data-rec="0" data-mode="0" data-shuffle="0" data-loop="0">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>THORN / 98 — Master Controller</title>
<meta name="description" content="THORN/98: a desktop music controller built from dials, faders, a joystick and tape keys.">
<style>
@font-face{font-family:"Saira";src:url(data:font/woff2;base64,) format("woff2");font-weight:300 800;font-display:swap}
@font-face{font-family:"Asap";src:url(data:font/woff2;base64,) format("woff2");font-weight:300 800;font-display:swap}

/* ───────────── Tokens (extracted from master-controllers.riv) ───────────── */
:root{
  --fog:#c9ced3; --alloy:#b2b6bd; --steel:#92959c; --graphite:#51575d; --slate:#3e3e40;
  --carbon:#0f1215; --soot:#2f2f2f; --signal:#fe5d01; --lime:#7bb470; --led:#a9d046; --amber:#ffbe00;
  --ink:#1b1d21; --ink-2:#4a4f56; --ink-3:#6d737a;
  --page:#bfc3c9;
  --noise:url("data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' width='220' height='220'><filter id='n'><feTurbulence type='fractalNoise' baseFrequency='.9' numOctaves='3' stitchTiles='stitch'/><feColorMatrix values='0 0 0 0 .5  0 0 0 0 .5  0 0 0 0 .5  0 0 0 .55 0'/></filter><rect width='100%' height='100%' filter='url(%23n)'/></svg>");
  --ease:cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1);
  --spring:cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1);
}
/* finish tokens: applied to <html> and to any element carrying its own data-finish */
[data-finish=fog]{
  --b1:#d3d8dd; --b2:#c3c8ce; --hl:rgba(255,255,255,.7); --sh:rgba(28,31,37,.5); --line:#a3a7ad;
  --lbl:#5d646a; --badge:#646970; --badge2:#f5f6f7; --hole:#38383b; --hole-end:#e7e8e9;
  --face1:#e4e8ec; --face2:#b6bac0; --ring:#3e4144; --grip1:#e8eaed; --grip2:#c1c5ca;
  --thumb1:#5d646a; --thumb2:#41464c; --key1:#d8dce0; --key2:#bec3c9; --keyedge:#f3ecec;
  --tick:#a7abb1; --house1:#eceef1; --house2:#bcc0c6; --plate1:#eef0f2; --plate2:#bcc0c6;
  --nub1:#f7f7f7; --nub2:#d3d4d6; --label-ink:#3e3e40; --icon:#2f2f2f; --swatch:#c9ced3;
}
[data-finish=graphite]{
  --b1:#62686f; --b2:#4b5056; --hl:rgba(255,255,255,.16); --sh:rgba(10,11,13,.6); --line:#383c41;
  --lbl:#b6bbc2; --badge:#d9dde1; --badge2:#8c9299; --hole:#17181a; --hole-end:#7d828a;
  --face1:#737980; --face2:#4a4f55; --ring:#202326; --grip1:#80868d; --grip2:#575c63;
  --thumb1:#d0d4d9; --thumb2:#a2a7ae; --key1:#5d636a; --key2:#474c52; --keyedge:#767c83;
  --tick:#7c828a; --house1:#6d737a; --house2:#464b51; --plate1:#737980; --plate2:#4a4f55;
  --nub1:#8f959c; --nub2:#5f656c; --label-ink:#e4e6e8; --icon:#eceef0; --swatch:#51575d;
}
[data-finish=sand]{
  --b1:#ebe6dd; --b2:#d9d2c6; --hl:rgba(255,255,255,.75); --sh:rgba(52,44,34,.42); --line:#bdb4a6;
  --lbl:#7a7266; --badge:#6e675c; --badge2:#fdfbf7; --hole:#3d3934; --hole-end:#f6f2ea;
  --face1:#f5f1ea; --face2:#cdc5b8; --ring:#4a443d; --grip1:#f7f4ee; --grip2:#d2cbbf;
  --thumb1:#6c6459; --thumb2:#4c463e; --key1:#e9e3d9; --key2:#cfc7ba; --keyedge:#faf6f0;
  --tick:#beb6a9; --house1:#f5f2ec; --house2:#cdc6ba; --plate1:#f6f3ee; --plate2:#cbc3b6;
  --nub1:#fdfcfa; --nub2:#e1dacf; --label-ink:#3d3934; --icon:#38342f; --swatch:#dad4c9;
}

*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
:root{--u:1px}
*{--q:max(1em,2px)}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth;-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%}
body{
  font-family:"Asap",ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--ink);background:var(--page);
  line-height:1.5;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;overflow-x:hidden;
}
body::before{content:"";position:fixed;inset:0;background:var(--noise);opacity:.22;mix-blend-mode:overlay;pointer-events:none;z-index:100}
button{font:inherit;color:inherit;background:none;border:0;cursor:pointer}
a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--signal);outline-offset:3px;border-radius:4px}
.wrap{width:min(1240px,100% - 40px);margin-inline:auto}
.kicker{font-family:Saira;font-weight:550;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink-3);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}
.kicker::before{content:"";width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--signal);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(254,93,1,.15)}
h1,h2,h3{font-family:Saira;font-weight:620;letter-spacing:-.025em;line-height:.98}
h2{font-size:clamp(36px,5.2vw,72px)}
.lede{font-size:clamp(17px,1.35vw,19px);color:var(--ink-2);max-width:34em;line-height:1.55}
.num{font-family:Saira;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}

/* ───────────── Buttons (tape-key language) ───────────── */
.btn{
  --h:52px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;height:var(--h);padding:0 22px 0 18px;border-radius:9px;
  font-family:Saira;font-weight:600;font-size:15px;letter-spacing:.02em;color:var(--ink);
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,#c4c9cf,#dde1e5 45%,#f3ecec 94%,#d9d4d4);
  box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.85),inset 0 -2px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.12),0 1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.08),0 10px 24px -10px rgba(25,28,34,.45);
  transition:transform .15s var(--ease),box-shadow .15s var(--ease);
}
.btn:hover{transform:translateY(-1px)}
.btn:active{transform:translateY(1px);box-shadow:inset 0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.18),0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.5)}
.btn .dot{width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--signal);box-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(254,93,1,.7)}
.btn.dark{color:#eceef0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#3c4146,#51575d 55%,#5d646a);box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.15),inset 0 -2px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.3),0 10px 24px -10px rgba(0,0,0,.6)}
.link{font-family:Saira;font-weight:550;font-size:15px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;color:var(--ink-2);padding:6px 2px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.18)}
.link:hover{color:var(--ink);border-color:var(--ink)}

/* ───────────── Nav ───────────── */
.nav{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;z-index:50;transition:background .3s,box-shadow .3s,backdrop-filter .3s}
.nav.scrolled{background:rgba(201,206,211,.72);backdrop-filter:blur(18px) saturate(1.3);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(18px) saturate(1.3);box-shadow:0 1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.08),0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.5) inset}
.nav .wrap{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;height:68px}
.brand{font-family:Saira;font-weight:650;font-size:17px;letter-spacing:.06em;color:#4b5056}
.brand span{color:#f7f8f9;font-weight:500;text-shadow:0 1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.12)}
.nav-links{display:flex;gap:30px;font-family:Saira;font-weight:500;font-size:14px;letter-spacing:.04em;color:var(--ink-2)}
.nav-links a:hover{color:var(--ink)}
.nav-right{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px}
.nav .btn{--h:40px;font-size:13.5px;padding:0 16px 0 14px}
.snd{width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;color:var(--ink-2);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,.12)}
.snd svg{width:18px;height:18px}
.snd[aria-pressed=false] .on{display:none}.snd[aria-pressed=true] .off{display:none}
@media (max-width:820px){.nav-links{display:none}}

/* ───────────── Hero ───────────── */
.hero{position:relative;padding:130px 0 70px;overflow:hidden;
  background:
    radial-gradient(70% 60% at 82% 0%,rgba(255,255,255,.55),transparent 70%),
    linear-gradient(100deg,#8b8e95 0%,#a9adb4 38%,#c3c6cb 70%,#cbced3 100%);
}
.beam{position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;
  background:linear-gradient(205deg,rgba(255,255,255,.55),rgba(255,255,255,.08) 55%,transparent 75%);
  clip-path:polygon(100% 0,38% 0,86% 58%,100% 58%);filter:blur(2px);-webkit-mask:linear-gradient(#000 25%,transparent 60%);mask:linear-gradient(#000 25%,transparent 60%)}
.hero-top{position:relative;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.25fr .75fr;gap:40px;align-items:end}
.hero h1{font-size:clamp(46px,7.4vw,118px);font-weight:640;color:#1e2125;margin-top:22px}
.hero h1 em{font-style:normal;color:#f4f5f6;text-shadow:0 1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.08)}
.hero-side{padding-bottom:10px}
.hero-side .lede{color:#3c4147}
.ctas{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:22px;margin-top:28px}
@media (max-width:900px){.hero-top{grid-template-columns:1fr}.hero{padding-top:110px}}

.stage{position:relative;margin-top:clamp(40px,6vw,80px);display:flex;justify-content:center;padding-bottom:clamp(10px,3vw,40px)}
.dev-hero{--u:min(1.72px,calc((100vw - 40px)/720))}
.readout{position:relative;margin-top:clamp(56px,7vw,90px);display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:16px 28px;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;
  padding:16px 20px;border-radius:12px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.18);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.35),0 1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.06)}
.ro{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px 26px;font-family:Saira;font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.08em;color:#40454b}
.ro b{font-weight:600;color:#1e2125;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.ro .st{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.ro .st i{width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:#7d8288;transition:background .3s,box-shadow .3s}
[data-power=on] .ro .st i{background:var(--led);box-shadow:0 0 10px var(--led)}
[data-rec="1"][data-power=on] .ro .st i{background:var(--signal);box-shadow:0 0 10px var(--signal)}
.finish-pick{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;font-family:Saira;font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.08em;color:#40454b}
.sw{display:flex;gap:8px}
.sw button{width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--swatch);box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.6),0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.3);position:relative;transition:transform .2s var(--spring)}
.sw button:hover{transform:scale(1.1)}
.sw button[aria-pressed=true]::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:-5px;border-radius:50%;box-shadow:0 0 0 1.5px #2b2e33}

/* ───────────── 3D SCENE ───────────── */
.scene{perspective:var(--p,2600px);perspective-origin:50% 35%;--rx:0deg;--ry:0deg;--gx:60%;--gy:20%;display:flex;justify-content:center}
.rig{transform-style:preserve-3d;transform:rotateX(var(--rx)) rotateY(var(--ry))}
.ly{position:absolute;display:block;pointer-events:none}
.p3{transform-style:preserve-3d}

/* ───────────── DEVICE (1em = 1 design unit from the 650×325 Rive artboard; depth 96) ───────────── */
.device{font-size:var(--u,1px);position:relative;width:651em;height:331em;flex:none;user-select:none;-webkit-user-select:none;touch-action:manipulation;
  transform-style:preserve-3d;transform-origin:50% 50% -48em}
.floor{position:absolute;left:-90em;top:331em;width:840em;height:300em;transform-origin:50% 0;transform:translateZ(70em) rotateX(90deg);pointer-events:none;
  background:radial-gradient(46% 30% at 47% 40%,rgba(10,12,16,.55),rgba(10,12,16,.22) 55%,transparent 78%),radial-gradient(70% 45% at 40% 45%,rgba(10,12,16,.16),transparent 75%);filter:blur(9em)}
.scene{position:relative}
.gshadow{position:absolute;left:50%;bottom:-13%;width:98%;height:24%;pointer-events:none;
  transform:translateX(calc(-50% + var(--sx,0) * 1px));
  background:radial-gradient(closest-side,rgba(12,14,18,.5),rgba(12,14,18,.22) 55%,transparent);filter:blur(10px)}
.gshadow::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:6%;right:4%;top:18%;height:22%;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(10,12,16,.45);filter:blur(6px)}
.face{position:absolute;backface-visibility:hidden;-webkit-backface-visibility:hidden;pointer-events:none;overflow:hidden}
.face::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:var(--noise);background-size:160em;opacity:.18}
.f-top{left:0;top:-96em;width:651em;height:96em;transform-origin:50% 100%;transform:translateZ(-1.5em) rotateX(90deg);border-radius:4em 4em 8em 8em;
  background:linear-gradient(0deg,color-mix(in srgb,var(--b1) 55%,#fff) 0,color-mix(in srgb,var(--b1) 80%,#fff) 3em,var(--b1) 20%,color-mix(in srgb,var(--b1) 90%,#000) 100%)}
.f-top .vent{position:absolute;left:338em;top:26em;width:280em;height:30em;border-radius:3em;
  background:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,color-mix(in srgb,var(--b2) 40%,#000) 0 2.6em,transparent 2.6em 7em);
  box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 .6em rgba(0,0,0,.05);-webkit-mask:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,#000 6%,#000 94%,transparent);mask:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,#000 6%,#000 94%,transparent)}
.f-top .seam{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:14em;height:1em;background:rgba(0,0,0,.18);box-shadow:0 1em 0 rgba(255,255,255,.25)}
.f-right{left:651em;top:0;width:96em;height:325em;transform-origin:0 50%;transform:translateZ(-1.5em) rotateY(90deg);border-radius:0 6em 6em 0;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,color-mix(in srgb,var(--b2) 70%,#fff) 0,color-mix(in srgb,var(--b2) 92%,#000) 3em,color-mix(in srgb,var(--b2) 80%,#000) 100%)}
.f-right::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(255,255,255,.18),transparent 40%,rgba(0,0,0,.12))}
.f-right .seam{position:absolute;top:0;bottom:0;left:80em;width:1em;background:rgba(0,0,0,.2);box-shadow:1em 0 0 rgba(255,255,255,.15)}
.port{position:absolute;background:#16171a;box-shadow:inset 0 1em 1.5em rgba(0,0,0,.9),0 0 0 1em color-mix(in srgb,var(--b2) 70%,#000),0 0 0 1.6em rgba(255,255,255,.15)}
.port.usb{left:30em;top:262em;width:22em;height:8em;border-radius:4em}
.port.usb::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:5em;right:5em;top:3.3em;height:1.4em;border-radius:1em;background:#55595f}
.port.jack{left:62em;top:259em;width:13em;height:13em;border-radius:50%}
.port.jack::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:4em;border-radius:50%;background:#000}
.port-lbl{position:absolute;top:calc(278*var(--u));font-family:Saira;font-size:5em;letter-spacing:.1em;color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--b2) 55%,#000)}
.f-left{left:-96em;top:0;width:96em;height:325em;transform-origin:100% 50%;transform:translateZ(-1.5em) rotateY(-90deg);border-radius:6em 0 0 6em;
  background:linear-gradient(270deg,color-mix(in srgb,var(--b2) 80%,#fff) 0,color-mix(in srgb,var(--b2) 72%,#000) 3em,color-mix(in srgb,var(--b2) 60%,#000))}
.f-bot{left:0;top:325em;width:651em;height:96em;transform-origin:50% 0;transform:translateZ(-1.5em) rotateX(-90deg);background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--b2) 45%,#000)}
.f-back{left:0;top:0;width:651em;height:325em;transform:translateZ(-96em) rotateY(180deg);background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--b2) 75%,#000);border-radius:8em}

.shell{position:absolute;left:0;top:0;width:651em;height:325em;border-radius:8em;transform-style:preserve-3d}
.plate{position:absolute;inset:0;border-radius:8em;pointer-events:none;transform:translateZ(-.2em);
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--b1),var(--b2) 60%);
  box-shadow:inset 0 1.4em 0 color-mix(in srgb,var(--b1) 40%,#fff),inset 0 3em 3em -2em rgba(255,255,255,.35),inset 0 -2em 0 rgba(0,0,0,.09),inset -1.6em 0 0 rgba(255,255,255,.35),inset 1.4em 0 0 rgba(0,0,0,.05);
  transition:background .6s var(--ease)}
.plate::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;border-radius:inherit;pointer-events:none;
  background:repeating-linear-gradient(0deg,rgba(255,255,255,.035) 0 calc(0.6*var(--q)),rgba(0,0,0,.018) calc(0.6*var(--q)) calc(1.4*var(--q)))}
.plate::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;border-radius:inherit;background:var(--noise);background-size:160em;opacity:.16;pointer-events:none}
.sheen{position:absolute;inset:0;border-radius:inherit;pointer-events:none;z-index:1;
  background:radial-gradient(55% 75% at var(--gx) var(--gy),rgba(255,255,255,.34),rgba(255,255,255,.08) 45%,transparent 70%)}
.ln{position:absolute;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--line) 85%,#000)}
.ln.h{height:1.2em;box-shadow:0 1.2em 0 var(--hl),0 -.6em 1.2em rgba(0,0,0,.06)}
.ln.v{width:1.2em;box-shadow:1.2em 0 0 var(--hl),-.6em 0 1.2em rgba(0,0,0,.06)}
.deck{position:absolute;left:0;top:163em;width:651em;height:162em;border-radius:0 0 8em 8em;pointer-events:none;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(0,0,0,.035),transparent 25%)}
.foot3{position:absolute;top:325em;width:20em;height:6em;transform-style:preserve-3d}
.ft{inset:0;border-radius:0 0 3em 3em;background:#26282b}
.ft.t{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#3a3d41,#5a5e63 50%,#2e3033)}
/* grille */
.hole{position:absolute;width:5.4em;height:5.4em;margin:-2.7em 0 0 -2.7em;border-radius:50%;
  background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 30%,#000,color-mix(in srgb,var(--hole) 60%,#000) 55%,var(--hole));
  box-shadow:inset 0 1.2em 1.2em rgba(0,0,0,.7),inset 0 -.4em .4em rgba(255,255,255,.12),0 .7em 0 var(--hl),0 -.4em .6em rgba(0,0,0,.12)}
.hole.e{background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 70%,var(--hole-end),color-mix(in srgb,var(--hole-end) 80%,#000));box-shadow:inset 0 .9em 1em rgba(0,0,0,.25),0 .6em 0 var(--hl)}
.badge{position:absolute;left:calc(33*var(--u));top:calc(47*var(--u));font-family:Saira;font-weight:600;font-size:10em;letter-spacing:.06em;color:var(--badge);white-space:nowrap;
  text-shadow:0 .08em 0 var(--hl),0 -.06em 0 rgba(0,0,0,.18)}
.badge span{color:var(--badge2);font-weight:500;text-shadow:0 .06em .1em rgba(0,0,0,.18)}
.engr{position:absolute;font-family:Saira;font-size:5.2em;letter-spacing:.22em;color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--lbl) 70%,transparent);text-shadow:0 .1em 0 var(--hl);white-space:nowrap}
/* side toggles (Tippy) — levers mounted on the right flank */
.tippy{position:absolute;left:651em;width:22em;height:18em;padding:0;transform-style:preserve-3d;transition:transform .25s var(--spring)}
.tippy[aria-pressed=true]{transform:translateX(-5em)}
.tp-l{left:0;top:0;width:20em;height:18em;border-radius:0 9em 9em 0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#3d4146,#1f2124)}
.tp-l.sh{box-shadow:-2em 3em 5em rgba(0,0,0,.35)}
.tp-f{left:0;top:0;width:20em;height:18em;border-radius:0 9em 9em 0;
  background:radial-gradient(circle at 40% 30%,#8a9097,#4a4f55 55%,#2a2d31);box-shadow:inset 0 1em 0 rgba(255,255,255,.18),inset -1em -1em 2em rgba(0,0,0,.3)}
.tippy:hover .tp-f{background:radial-gradient(circle at 40% 30%,#9aa0a7,#555a60 55%,#2f3236)}
.tippy[aria-pressed=true] .tp-f::after{content:"";position:absolute;right:4em;top:7em;width:4em;height:4em;border-radius:50%;background:var(--led);box-shadow:0 0 4em var(--led)}
[data-power=off] .tippy .tp-f::after{background:#6c7076;box-shadow:none}

/* screen */
.screen{position:absolute;width:315em;height:142em;border-radius:22em;background:var(--carbon);overflow:hidden;font-family:Saira;color:#fff;
  box-shadow:0 0 0 1em #2a2c30,inset 0 3em 9em rgba(0,0,0,.95),inset 0 -1em 0 rgba(255,255,255,.03)}
.screen::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;border-radius:inherit;pointer-events:none;
  background:radial-gradient(45% 60% at var(--gx) -10%,rgba(255,255,255,.12),transparent 70%),linear-gradient(162deg,rgba(255,255,255,.085),rgba(255,255,255,.015) 38%,transparent 39%),radial-gradient(140% 120% at 50% 70%,transparent 70%,rgba(0,0,0,.25))}
.glow{position:absolute;inset:0;opacity:0;transition:opacity .9s var(--ease);
  background:radial-gradient(60% 75% at 50% 112%,rgba(150,196,62,.6),rgba(110,150,40,.18) 50%,transparent 75%)}
[data-power=on] .glow{opacity:1}
[data-power=on][data-playing="1"] .glow{animation:breathe 4.2s ease-in-out infinite}
[data-power=on][data-rec="1"] .glow{background:radial-gradient(60% 75% at 50% 112%,rgba(254,93,1,.5),rgba(180,60,0,.16) 50%,transparent 75%)}
@keyframes breathe{50%{opacity:.72}}
.sui{position:absolute;inset:0;opacity:0;transform:scaleY(.015) scaleX(.6);filter:brightness(3);transition:transform .5s var(--ease),opacity .25s,filter .6s}
[data-power=on] .sui{opacity:1;transform:none;filter:none}
.s-mode{position:absolute;left:18em;top:12em;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:1em;color:#d6d6d6}
.s-mode button{width:10em;height:12em;display:grid;place-items:center;color:#cfcfcf}
.s-mode button svg{width:4.6em;height:6em}
.s-mode button:hover{color:var(--led)}
.s-mode .lbl{font-size:7.4em;letter-spacing:.1em;font-weight:450;min-width:4.4em;text-align:center}
.s-toast{position:absolute;right:calc(22*var(--u));top:calc(14*var(--u));font-size:7.4em;letter-spacing:.1em;color:var(--led);opacity:0;transition:opacity .3s;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;white-space:nowrap}
.s-toast.show{opacity:1}
.s-flags{position:absolute;right:calc(22*var(--u));top:calc(15*var(--u));display:flex;gap:calc(6*var(--u));font-size:6.6em;letter-spacing:.12em;color:#6c7076;transition:opacity .3s}
.s-toast.show+.s-flags{opacity:0}
.s-flags .f-shuf,.s-flags .f-loop{display:none}
[data-shuffle="1"] .s-flags .f-shuf,[data-loop="1"] .s-flags .f-loop{display:inline;color:var(--led)}
.pg{position:absolute;inset:0;opacity:0;visibility:hidden;transition:opacity .35s,visibility .35s}
[data-mode="0"] .pg-0,[data-mode="1"] .pg-1,[data-mode="2"] .pg-2{opacity:1;visibility:visible}
.s-title{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:calc(34*var(--u));text-align:center;font-size:23em;font-weight:650;line-height:1.1;letter-spacing:-.005em;white-space:nowrap}
.s-artist{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:calc(65*var(--u));text-align:center;font-size:12em;font-weight:350;color:#d4d4d4;line-height:1.2}
.s-title,.s-artist{transition:transform .45s var(--ease),opacity .3s}
.swap .s-title,.swap .s-artist{opacity:0;transform:translateY(-6em)}
.s-bar{position:absolute;left:46em;top:100em;width:223em;height:1.4em;background:rgba(255,255,255,.32);border-radius:1em;cursor:pointer}
.s-bar::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:-6em 0}
.s-bar i{position:absolute;left:0;top:0;bottom:0;width:0;background:var(--lime);border-radius:inherit}
.s-bar b{position:absolute;top:50%;left:0;width:5.6em;height:5.6em;margin:-2.8em 0 0 -2.8em;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;box-shadow:0 0 6em rgba(169,208,70,.8)}
.s-time{position:absolute;right:46em;top:104em;font-size:6em;color:#8f9399;letter-spacing:.06em;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.s-ctl{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:112em;height:26em}
.s-ctl button{position:absolute;top:0;width:24em;height:26em;margin-left:-12em;display:grid;place-items:center;color:#f2f2f2;transition:transform .15s,color .2s}
.s-ctl button:active{transform:scale(.9)}
.s-ctl button svg{width:11em;height:11em}
.s-ctl .sm svg{width:9.5em;height:9.5em}
.s-ctl .pp{width:24em;height:24em;top:1em;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;color:var(--carbon);box-shadow:0 0 12em rgba(255,255,255,.25)}
.s-ctl .pp svg{width:8.5em;height:8.5em}
.pp .i-play{display:none}.pp .i-stop{display:block}
[data-playing="0"] .pp .i-play{display:block}[data-playing="0"] .pp .i-stop{display:none}
[data-shuffle="1"] .b-shuf,[data-loop="1"] .b-loop{color:var(--led)}
/* standby overlay (display section) */
.s-sleep{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:3;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:12em;
  background:radial-gradient(70% 80% at 50% 120%,rgba(169,208,70,.10),transparent 70%);transition:opacity .45s var(--ease),visibility .45s}
[data-power=on] .s-sleep{opacity:0;visibility:hidden;pointer-events:none}
.sl-mark{font-size:9em;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.32em;color:#3d4248;margin-right:-.32em}
.sl-mark span{color:#2b2f34;font-weight:500}
.sl-badge{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7em;padding:4.5em 13em 4.5em 4.5em;border-radius:30em;cursor:pointer;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(255,255,255,.07),rgba(255,255,255,.02));
  box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 .9em rgba(169,208,70,.38),inset 0 1em 0 rgba(255,255,255,.06),0 0 24em rgba(169,208,70,.14);
  transition:box-shadow .3s,transform .2s var(--spring)}
.sl-badge:hover{transform:scale(1.04);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 .9em rgba(169,208,70,.7),inset 0 1em 0 rgba(255,255,255,.08),0 0 30em rgba(169,208,70,.3)}
.sl-badge:active{transform:scale(.98)}
.sl-ico{position:relative;width:20em;height:20em;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;color:#f4ffd6;
  background:radial-gradient(circle at 45% 35%,#e3f58a,#a9d046 55%,#6f9a28);box-shadow:0 0 10em 1em rgba(169,208,70,.55),inset 0 -1em 2em rgba(60,90,0,.35)}
.sl-ico::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:-3em;border-radius:50%;box-shadow:0 0 0 .9em rgba(169,208,70,.6);animation:slring 2s var(--ease) infinite}
@keyframes slring{0%{transform:scale(.85);opacity:1}100%{transform:scale(1.6);opacity:0}}
.sl-ico svg{width:10em;height:10em}
.sl-txt{font-size:7.6em;font-weight:550;letter-spacing:.2em;color:#eef1f3;white-space:nowrap}
.sl-sub{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4em;color:#5f656c}
.sl-sub i{width:3.6em;height:3.6em;border-radius:50%;background:var(--signal);box-shadow:0 0 5em rgba(254,93,1,.8);animation:slblink 2.4s ease-in-out infinite}
.sl-sub span{font-size:6em;letter-spacing:.3em}
@keyframes slblink{50%{opacity:.25}}
/* radio page */
.r-freq{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:calc(24*var(--u));text-align:center;font-size:42em;font-weight:300;letter-spacing:-.02em;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;line-height:1.1}
.r-freq small{font-size:.26em;font-weight:450;letter-spacing:.14em;color:#bfc3c8;margin-left:.6em}
.r-sub{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:calc(76*var(--u));text-align:center;font-size:7.4em;letter-spacing:.2em;color:#9aa0a6}
.r-scale{position:absolute;left:46em;top:98em;width:223em;height:12em;background:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(255,255,255,.42) 0 .9em,transparent .9em 5.475em);-webkit-mask:linear-gradient(#000 0 45%,transparent 45%);mask:linear-gradient(#000 0 45%,transparent 45%)}
.r-scale2{position:absolute;left:46em;top:98em;width:223em;height:9em;background:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(255,255,255,.7) 0 1em,transparent 1em 21.9em)}
.r-needle{position:absolute;top:94em;left:0;width:1.6em;height:18em;margin-left:-.8em;background:var(--signal);box-shadow:0 0 6em rgba(254,93,1,.9);border-radius:1em;transition:left .12s}
.r-lbls{position:absolute;left:calc(40*var(--u));top:calc(115*var(--u));width:calc(235*var(--u));display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:6em;color:#7f858b;letter-spacing:.05em}
/* tape page */
.t-count{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:calc(36*var(--u));text-align:center;font-size:34em;font-weight:350;letter-spacing:.08em;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;line-height:1.1}
.t-side{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:calc(26*var(--u));text-align:center;font-size:6.6em;letter-spacing:.24em;color:#8b9096}
.t-stat{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:calc(84*var(--u));text-align:center;font-size:8em;letter-spacing:.2em;color:#cfd2d6}
[data-rec="1"] .t-stat{color:var(--signal)}
.reel{position:absolute;top:96em;width:34em;height:34em;margin-left:-17em;color:#6d7278}
.reel svg{width:100%;height:100%}
.tapeline{position:absolute;left:107em;right:107em;top:126em;height:1.2em;background:#3a2f28}

/* screen module: raised bezel + glass */
.scr3{position:absolute;width:315em;height:142em;transform-style:preserve-3d}
.bz{left:-4em;top:-4em;width:323em;height:150em;border-radius:26em;border:4.4em solid #63676d;background:transparent}
.bz.sh{box-shadow:-10em 12em 22em rgba(0,0,0,.25),0 0 0 .8em rgba(0,0,0,.05)}
.bz.t{border-color:transparent;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#dfe2e5,#9a9ea4 45%,#80848a) border-box;-webkit-mask:linear-gradient(#000 0 0) border-box exclude,linear-gradient(#000 0 0) padding-box;mask:linear-gradient(#000 0 0) border-box exclude,linear-gradient(#000 0 0) padding-box;box-shadow:none}
/* dials: flange + extruded knob + raised grip fin */
.dial{position:absolute;width:180em;height:180em;transform-style:preserve-3d}
.d-fl{left:23em;top:24em;width:132em;height:132em;border-radius:50%;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--ring) 80%,#000)}
.d-fl.sh{box-shadow:-12em 16em 24em rgba(0,0,0,.32),-3em 4em 6em rgba(0,0,0,.25)}
.d-fl.t{background:radial-gradient(circle at 60% 30%,color-mix(in srgb,var(--ring) 70%,#fff),var(--ring) 60%);box-shadow:inset 0 .8em 0 rgba(255,255,255,.25)}
.d-knob{position:absolute;left:27em;top:28em;width:124em;height:124em;border-radius:50%;cursor:grab;touch-action:none;transform-style:preserve-3d}
.d-knob:active{cursor:grabbing}
.d-wall{inset:0;border-radius:50%;
  background:linear-gradient(100deg,color-mix(in srgb,var(--face2) 55%,#000) 0,var(--face2) 22%,color-mix(in srgb,var(--face1) 70%,#fff) 55%,var(--face2) 78%,color-mix(in srgb,var(--face2) 62%,#000) 100%)}
.d-wall.k{background:repeating-conic-gradient(from 0deg,rgba(0,0,0,.11) 0 2deg,rgba(255,255,255,.07) 2deg 4deg),linear-gradient(100deg,color-mix(in srgb,var(--face2) 55%,#000) 0,var(--face2) 22%,color-mix(in srgb,var(--face1) 70%,#fff) 55%,var(--face2) 78%,color-mix(in srgb,var(--face2) 62%,#000) 100%)}
.d-top{inset:0;border-radius:50%;
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle,transparent 0 41%,rgba(0,0,0,.1) 41.5%,rgba(255,255,255,.5) 42.5%,transparent 43.5%),
    repeating-radial-gradient(circle,rgba(255,255,255,.07) 0 calc(0.5*var(--q)),rgba(0,0,0,.035) calc(0.5*var(--q)) calc(1.1*var(--q))),
    conic-gradient(from 200deg,rgba(255,255,255,0),rgba(255,255,255,.45) 35deg,rgba(255,255,255,0) 85deg,rgba(0,0,0,.08) 150deg,rgba(255,255,255,0) 190deg,rgba(255,255,255,.38) 215deg,rgba(255,255,255,0) 265deg,rgba(0,0,0,.07) 330deg,rgba(255,255,255,0)),
    radial-gradient(circle at 35% 28%,var(--face1),var(--face2) 88%);
  box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1.4em rgba(255,255,255,.28),inset 0 0 0 1.6em rgba(0,0,0,.06),inset -3em -4em 7em rgba(0,0,0,.1)}
.d-rot{position:absolute;inset:0;transform-style:preserve-3d;transform:translateZ(21.4em) rotate(var(--a,0deg));transition:transform .14s var(--ease)}
.g-wall{left:54.5em;top:1.8em;width:15em;height:120.4em;border-radius:4em;background:linear-gradient(90deg,color-mix(in srgb,var(--grip2) 55%,#000),color-mix(in srgb,var(--grip2) 85%,#000) 50%,color-mix(in srgb,var(--grip2) 50%,#000))}
.g-wall.sh{box-shadow:-5em 6em 8em rgba(0,0,0,.28)}
.g-top{left:54.5em;top:1.8em;width:15em;height:120.4em;border-radius:4em;
  background:
    repeating-linear-gradient(0deg,rgba(0,0,0,.09) 0 calc(0.6*var(--q)),rgba(255,255,255,.18) calc(0.6*var(--q)) calc(1.6*var(--q))) top/100% 22em no-repeat,
    repeating-linear-gradient(0deg,rgba(0,0,0,.09) 0 calc(0.6*var(--q)),rgba(255,255,255,.18) calc(0.6*var(--q)) calc(1.6*var(--q))) bottom/100% 22em no-repeat,
    linear-gradient(90deg,var(--grip2),var(--grip1) 28%,color-mix(in srgb,var(--grip1) 50%,#fff) 46%,var(--grip1) 62%,color-mix(in srgb,var(--grip2) 88%,#000));
  box-shadow:inset 0 1em 0 rgba(255,255,255,.55),inset 0 -1em 0 rgba(0,0,0,.12)}
.g-top::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:6.6em;top:5em;width:1.8em;height:12em;border-radius:1em;background:#1f2123;box-shadow:0 .5em 0 rgba(255,255,255,.4)}
.d-lbl{position:absolute;font-family:Saira;font-size:7.6em;color:var(--lbl);transform:translate(-50%,-50%);line-height:1;font-weight:450;transition:color .2s;text-shadow:0 .08em 0 var(--hl)}
.d-lbl.hit{color:var(--signal);text-shadow:0 0 .6em rgba(254,93,1,.4)}
.d-tick{position:absolute;width:1.5em;height:5em;margin:-2.5em 0 0 -.75em;border-radius:1em;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--tick) 85%,#000);box-shadow:.4em .4em 0 var(--hl)}
/* faders */
.fader{position:absolute;width:44em;height:92em;transform-style:preserve-3d}
.f-house{left:10em;top:0;width:24em;height:72em;border-radius:12em;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--house2) 75%,#000)}
.f-house.sh{box-shadow:-5em 7em 10em rgba(0,0,0,.22)}
.f-house.t{background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--house1),var(--house2));box-shadow:inset 0 1em 0 rgba(255,255,255,.8),inset 0 -1.2em 2em rgba(0,0,0,.12),inset 1em 0 1em rgba(255,255,255,.3)}
.f-slot{left:18.5em;top:6em;width:7em;height:60em;border-radius:4em;background:linear-gradient(#141516,#45484d);box-shadow:inset 0 2.5em 3em rgba(0,0,0,.8),inset 0 -1em 1em rgba(255,255,255,.08),0 .8em 0 rgba(255,255,255,.55)}
.f-hit{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:-4em;height:84em;cursor:ns-resize;touch-action:none}
.f-thumb{position:absolute;left:11.5em;top:41em;width:21em;height:34em;transform-style:preserve-3d;transition:top .08s linear;pointer-events:none}
.t-wall{inset:0;border-radius:7.5em;background:linear-gradient(90deg,color-mix(in srgb,var(--thumb2) 60%,#000),color-mix(in srgb,var(--thumb2) 85%,#000) 60%,color-mix(in srgb,var(--thumb2) 55%,#000))}
.t-wall.sh{box-shadow:-7em 10em 12em rgba(0,0,0,.42),-2em 3em 3em rgba(0,0,0,.3)}
.t-top{inset:0;border-radius:7.5em;
  background:repeating-linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(255,255,255,.12) 0 calc(0.7*var(--q)),rgba(0,0,0,.2) calc(0.7*var(--q)) calc(2.2*var(--q))) center/100% 18em no-repeat,
    linear-gradient(180deg,color-mix(in srgb,var(--thumb1) 70%,#fff),var(--thumb1) 24%,var(--thumb2));
  box-shadow:inset 0 1.2em 0 rgba(255,255,255,.28),inset 0 -1.5em 0 rgba(0,0,0,.25),inset 1em 0 1em rgba(255,255,255,.1)}
.f-lbl{position:absolute;left:calc(-10*var(--u));right:calc(-10*var(--u));top:calc(80*var(--u));text-align:center;font-family:Asap;font-weight:620;font-size:7.6em;letter-spacing:.03em;color:var(--label-ink);text-shadow:0 .08em 0 var(--hl)}
/* joystick: machined base + dome */
.joy{position:absolute;width:100em;height:100em;transform-style:preserve-3d}
.joy svg.ticks{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;overflow:visible}
.joy .arc{transition:transform .35s var(--spring);transform-origin:50px 50px}
.j-base{left:19em;top:19em;width:62em;height:62em;border-radius:50%;background:linear-gradient(100deg,color-mix(in srgb,var(--plate2) 55%,#000),color-mix(in srgb,var(--plate1) 80%,#000) 55%,color-mix(in srgb,var(--plate2) 55%,#000))}
.j-base.sh{box-shadow:-8em 10em 16em rgba(0,0,0,.3)}
.j-plate{left:19em;top:19em;width:62em;height:62em;border-radius:50%;
  background:repeating-radial-gradient(circle,rgba(255,255,255,.08) 0 calc(0.5*var(--q)),rgba(0,0,0,.04) calc(0.5*var(--q)) calc(1.1*var(--q))),
    conic-gradient(from 200deg,transparent,rgba(255,255,255,.5) 35deg,transparent 85deg,rgba(0,0,0,.08) 150deg,transparent 190deg,rgba(255,255,255,.4) 215deg,transparent 265deg),
    radial-gradient(circle at 40% 32%,var(--plate1),var(--plate2) 90%);
  box-shadow:inset 0 1.4em 1em rgba(255,255,255,.7),inset 0 -2em 3em rgba(0,0,0,.14)}
.j-plate::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:6em;border-radius:50%;box-shadow:inset 0 1em 2em rgba(0,0,0,.2),0 1em 0 rgba(255,255,255,.6)}
.j-lift{position:absolute;left:32em;top:32em;width:36em;height:36em;transform-style:preserve-3d;transform:translateZ(7.4em)}
.j-nub{position:absolute;inset:0;border-radius:50%;cursor:grab;touch-action:none;transform-style:preserve-3d;transition:transform .35s var(--spring)}
.j-nub.drag{transition:none;cursor:grabbing}
.j-neck{left:7em;top:7em;width:22em;height:22em;border-radius:50%;background:#55595f}
.j-neck.sh{box-shadow:-6em 8em 10em rgba(0,0,0,.35)}
.j-dome{border-radius:50%}
/* tape keys: extruded, sink when latched */
.keys{position:absolute;width:63em;height:131em;transform-style:preserve-3d}
.key{position:absolute;left:0;width:63em;height:42.9em;padding:0;transform-style:preserve-3d;transition:transform .12s var(--ease)}
.k-wall{inset:0;border-radius:2em;background:linear-gradient(90deg,color-mix(in srgb,var(--key2) 55%,#000),color-mix(in srgb,var(--key2) 78%,#000))}
.k-wall.sh{box-shadow:-4em 5em 8em rgba(0,0,0,.25)}
.k-face{position:absolute;inset:0;border-radius:2.4em;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(255,255,255,.18),transparent 30%,rgba(0,0,0,.05)),linear-gradient(90deg,var(--key2),var(--key1) 35%,var(--key1) 70%,var(--keyedge) 94%,color-mix(in srgb,var(--key2) 90%,#000));
  box-shadow:inset 0 1em 0 rgba(255,255,255,.6),inset 0 -1.2em 0 rgba(0,0,0,.16),inset 1em 0 0 rgba(0,0,0,.06);transform:translateZ(7.6em);transition:box-shadow .12s}
.key:hover .k-face{box-shadow:inset 0 1em 0 rgba(255,255,255,.6),inset 0 -1.2em 0 rgba(0,0,0,.16),inset 0 0 0 100em rgba(255,255,255,.07)}
.key.down{transform:translateZ(-5.5em)}
.key.down .k-face{box-shadow:inset 0 2.5em 4em rgba(0,0,0,.18),inset 0 -.5em 0 rgba(255,255,255,.3)}
.key i{position:absolute;left:14.5em;top:50%;transition:transform .12s}
.k-stop i{width:5.6em;height:5.6em;margin-top:-2.8em;background:var(--icon);border-radius:.6em;box-shadow:0 .5em 0 rgba(255,255,255,.4)}
.k-play i{width:0;height:0;margin-top:-3.2em;border-left:3.6em solid transparent;border-right:3.6em solid transparent;border-bottom:6em solid var(--icon);filter:drop-shadow(0 .5em 0 rgba(255,255,255,.4))}
.k-rec i{width:6.4em;height:6.4em;margin-top:-3.2em;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle at 40% 35%,#ff9a5a,var(--signal) 60%,#c84800);box-shadow:0 0 0 .7em rgba(254,93,1,.18)}
[data-rec="1"] .k-rec i{box-shadow:0 0 6em 1em rgba(254,93,1,.75);animation:recblink 1.1s steps(1) infinite}
@keyframes recblink{50%{background:#c44700;box-shadow:none}}
/* power */
.power{position:absolute;width:40em;height:31em;display:grid;place-items:center;transform-style:preserve-3d}
.pw{position:relative;width:23em;height:23em;border-radius:50%;padding:0;transform-style:preserve-3d}
.pw-ring{inset:0;border-radius:50%;background:linear-gradient(100deg,#6e7278,#9da1a7 55%,#6a6e74)}
.pw-ring.sh{box-shadow:-5em 6em 8em rgba(0,0,0,.3)}
.pw-rtop{inset:0;border-radius:50%;background:repeating-radial-gradient(circle,rgba(255,255,255,.1) 0 calc(0.4*var(--q)),rgba(0,0,0,.04) calc(0.4*var(--q)) calc(0.9*var(--q))),linear-gradient(180deg,#f2f3f5,#aeb2b8);box-shadow:inset 0 .8em 0 rgba(255,255,255,.8),inset 0 -1em 1em rgba(0,0,0,.15)}
.pw .core{position:absolute;inset:3.4em;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;color:#cfcfcf;transform:translateZ(4.6em);
  background:radial-gradient(circle at 45% 35%,#7a7878,#5e5c5c 55%,#4a484d);box-shadow:inset 0 1.2em 2em rgba(0,0,0,.45),0 .6em 0 rgba(0,0,0,.25);transition:background .35s,box-shadow .35s,color .35s}
.pw svg{width:8.5em;height:8.5em}
[data-power=on] .pw .core{color:#f6ffe0;background:radial-gradient(circle at 45% 35%,#eaf99a,#a9d046 55%,#78a12c);box-shadow:inset 0 -1em 2em rgba(60,90,0,.35),inset 0 1em 0 rgba(255,255,255,.4),0 0 9em 2em rgba(169,208,70,.55)}
.pulse::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:-4em;border-radius:50%;box-shadow:0 0 0 1.2em rgba(254,93,1,.55);animation:ring 1.8s var(--ease) infinite}
[data-power=on] .pulse::after{display:none}
@keyframes ring{0%{transform:translateZ(1em) scale(.8);opacity:1}100%{transform:translateZ(1em) scale(1.7);opacity:0}}
.hint{position:absolute;left:calc(318*var(--u));top:calc(350*var(--u));font-family:Saira;font-size:11em;letter-spacing:.14em;color:#3b3f45;white-space:nowrap;transition:opacity .4s;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.7em}
.hint::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:-1.2em;top:.5em;width:.8em;height:1px;background:#3b3f45}
[data-power=on] .hint{opacity:0}
.hint b{font-weight:600;color:#1e2125}

/* ───────────── Sections ───────────── */
section{position:relative}
.sec{padding:clamp(90px,11vw,150px) 0}
.sec-head{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:30px 60px;align-items:end;margin-bottom:clamp(40px,5vw,70px)}
.sec-head h2{margin-top:18px}
@media (max-width:860px){.sec-head{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.controls{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#cbced3,#c2c6cc)}
.bento{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:18px}
.tile{position:relative;border-radius:22px;overflow:hidden;display:flex;flex-direction:column;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--b1),var(--b2));
  box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 var(--hl),0 1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.08),0 30px 50px -30px var(--sh)}
.tile::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:var(--noise);opacity:.3;mix-blend-mode:soft-light;pointer-events:none}
.tile.wide{grid-column:span 2}
.t-stage{position:relative;flex:1;min-height:300px;display:grid;place-items:center;padding:30px 20px 10px}
.t-copy{position:relative;z-index:1;padding:0 28px 28px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 1fr;gap:4px 16px}
.t-copy .n{font-family:Saira;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.14em;color:var(--lbl);padding-top:5px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.t-copy h3{font-size:22px;letter-spacing:-.01em;color:var(--label-ink)}
.t-copy p{grid-column:2;color:var(--lbl);font-size:15px;max-width:30em}
.t-val{position:absolute;top:22px;right:24px;font-family:Saira;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.12em;color:var(--lbl);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.t-val b{color:var(--label-ink);font-weight:600}
.kit{position:relative;font-size:var(--u)}
.kit{transform-style:preserve-3d}
.kit>.dial,.kit>.fader,.kit>.joy,.kit>.keys,.kit>.power,.kit>.scr3{position:relative}
.k-dials{--u:min(1.55px,calc((100vw - 90px)/380));display:flex;gap:30em}
.k-faders{--u:min(2.4px,calc((100vw - 90px)/130));display:flex;gap:20em}
.k-joy{--u:2.3px}
.k-keys{--u:1.85px}
.k-power{--u:3.6px}
.tile .glow-led{position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(40% 40% at 50% 45%,rgba(169,208,70,.35),transparent 70%);opacity:0;transition:opacity .6s}
[data-power=on] .tile .glow-led{opacity:1}
@media (max-width:980px){.bento{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.tile.wide{grid-column:span 2}}
@media (max-width:640px){.bento{grid-template-columns:1fr}.tile.wide{grid-column:auto}.t-stage{min-height:250px}}

/* display section */
.display{background:var(--carbon);color:#e6e8ea;overflow:hidden}
.display::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:50%;bottom:-30%;width:120%;height:90%;transform:translateX(-50%);
  background:radial-gradient(50% 50% at 50% 50%,rgba(150,196,62,.22),transparent 70%);opacity:.35;transition:opacity 1s;pointer-events:none}
[data-power=on] .display::before{opacity:1}
[data-power=on][data-rec="1"] .display::before{background:radial-gradient(50% 50% at 50% 50%,rgba(254,93,1,.2),transparent 70%)}
.display .kicker{color:#8a9097}
.display .lede{color:#a5abb2}
.disp-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 300px;gap:50px;align-items:center}
.k-screen{--u:min(2.45px,calc((100vw - 40px)/330));display:flex;justify-content:center}
.k-screen .scr3{position:relative}
.queue{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px}
.queue h4{font-family:Saira;font-weight:500;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.18em;color:#6f757c;margin-bottom:10px;text-transform:uppercase}
.q{display:grid;grid-template-columns:28px 1fr auto;align-items:center;gap:12px;text-align:left;padding:14px 14px;border-radius:12px;transition:background .2s}
.q:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.05)}
.q .i{font-family:Saira;font-size:12px;color:#6f757c;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.q .tt{font-family:Saira;font-weight:600;font-size:18px;color:#e9ebed;line-height:1.15}
.q .aa{display:block;font-family:Asap;font-weight:400;font-size:14px;color:#8a9097}
.q .eq{display:flex;gap:2px;align-items:flex-end;height:14px;opacity:0}
.q .eq span{width:3px;background:var(--led);border-radius:1px;height:30%}
.q.cur{background:rgba(169,208,70,.08);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(169,208,70,.25)}
.q.cur .i{color:var(--led)}
[data-power=on] .q.cur .eq{opacity:1}
[data-power=on][data-playing="1"] .q.cur .eq span{animation:eq .9s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
.q .eq span:nth-child(2){animation-delay:-.3s!important}.q .eq span:nth-child(3){animation-delay:-.6s!important}
@keyframes eq{0%{height:20%}100%{height:100%}}
.disp-power{margin-top:22px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;font-family:Saira;font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.12em;color:#8a9097}
.disp-power .kit{--u:2.2px}
.facts{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:30px;margin-top:clamp(50px,6vw,80px);padding-top:30px;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1)}
.facts dt{font-family:Saira;font-weight:600;font-size:19px;color:#eef0f2}
.facts dd{color:#8a9097;font-size:15px;margin-top:6px;max-width:24em}
@media (max-width:900px){.disp-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.facts{grid-template-columns:1fr}}

/* finish section */
.finish{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#c6cacf,#bcc0c6)}
.fin-cards{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:18px}
.fin{position:relative;text-align:left;cursor:pointer;border-radius:22px;padding:26px 24px 24px;overflow:hidden;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.2);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.35),0 1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.05);transition:background .3s,box-shadow .3s,transform .3s var(--ease)}
.fin:hover{transform:translateY(-3px)}
.fin[aria-pressed=true]{background:rgba(255,255,255,.42);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1.5px #2b2e33,0 30px 50px -30px rgba(0,0,0,.4)}
.fin .mini{--u:min(.5px,calc((100vw - 120px)/680));display:flex;justify-content:center;padding:26px 0 40px;pointer-events:none}
.fin .row{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px}
.fin h3{font-size:24px}
.fin .chip{width:22px;height:22px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--swatch);box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.6),0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.3)}
.fin p{color:var(--ink-2);font-size:15px;margin-top:6px}
.fin .hex{font-family:Saira;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.12em;color:var(--ink-3);margin-top:14px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.accents{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:18px;margin-top:18px}
.acc{border-radius:18px;padding:20px 22px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between;min-height:150px;color:#fff;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.acc::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:var(--noise);opacity:.25;mix-blend-mode:soft-light}
.acc b{font-family:Saira;font-weight:600;font-size:18px;position:relative;z-index:1}
.acc span{font-family:Saira;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.12em;opacity:.8;position:relative;z-index:1}
.acc small{display:block;font-family:Asap;font-size:14px;letter-spacing:0;opacity:.85;margin-top:4px}
.acc.sig{background:linear-gradient(140deg,#ff7a2a,#fe5d01 50%,#d84d00)}
.acc.lim{background:linear-gradient(140deg,#c4e070,#a9d046 45%,#7bb470);color:#1d2a0a}
.acc.car{background:linear-gradient(160deg,#2f2f2f,#0f1215)}
.acc.typ{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#e4e7ea,#cfd3d8);color:var(--ink)}
.acc.typ .big{font-family:Saira;font-weight:300;font-size:46px;line-height:1;letter-spacing:-.02em;position:relative;z-index:1}
@media (max-width:900px){.fin-cards{grid-template-columns:1fr}.fin .mini{--u:min(.62px,calc((100vw - 110px)/680))}.accents{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}}

/* specs */
.specs{background:#c2c6cc}
.spec-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1.4fr;gap:60px}
.spec-list{border-top:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.14)}
.spec-list div{display:grid;grid-template-columns:180px 1fr;gap:20px;padding:18px 0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.1);box-shadow:0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.35)}
.spec-list dt{font-family:Saira;font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink-3);padding-top:2px}
.spec-list dd{font-size:17px;color:var(--ink)}
@media (max-width:860px){.spec-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:30px}.spec-list div{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:4px}}

.spec-side{position:sticky;top:100px;align-self:start}
.spec-dev{--u:min(.72px,calc((100vw - 60px)/680));margin-top:50px}
.spec-cap{margin-top:34px;font-size:14px;color:var(--ink-3)}
.spec-cap b{color:var(--ink);font-weight:600}
@media (max-width:860px){.spec-side{position:static}}
/* final CTA */
.final{padding:clamp(110px,13vw,180px) 0;text-align:center;overflow:hidden;
  background:radial-gradient(50% 45% at 50% 42%,rgba(255,255,255,.38),transparent 75%),linear-gradient(180deg,#bcc0c6,#a5a9b0)}
.final h2{font-size:clamp(54px,9vw,140px)}
.final .lede{margin:22px auto 0;text-align:center}
.final .k-power{--u:min(4.4px,calc((100vw - 40px)/60));display:flex;justify-content:center}
.final .scene{margin:40px 0 10px}
.final .ctas{justify-content:center}
.final .note{margin-top:22px;font-family:Saira;font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.12em;color:var(--ink-3)}
footer{background:#a5a9b0;padding:30px 0 40px;font-size:14px;color:#41464c}
footer .wrap{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;border-top:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.12);padding-top:26px}

.toast{position:fixed;left:50%;bottom:28px;transform:translate(-50%,30px);opacity:0;z-index:60;padding:12px 18px;border-radius:10px;background:#0f1215;color:#eef0f2;font-family:Saira;font-size:14px;letter-spacing:.04em;box-shadow:0 20px 40px -12px rgba(0,0,0,.5);transition:all .4s var(--ease);pointer-events:none;display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center}
.toast.show{opacity:1;transform:translate(-50%,0)}
.toast i{width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--signal)}

.reveal{opacity:0;transform:translateY(26px);transition:opacity .9s var(--ease),transform .9s var(--ease)}
.reveal.in{opacity:1;transform:none}
.dev-in{opacity:0;transform:translateY(40px) scale(.98);transition:opacity 1.2s var(--ease) .15s,transform 1.4s var(--ease) .15s}
.dev-in.in{opacity:1;transform:none}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
  *,*::before,*::after{animation:none!important;transition-duration:.01ms!important}
  .reveal,.dev-in{opacity:1;transform:none}
  html{scroll-behavior:auto}
}
</style>
</head>
<body>

<nav class="nav" id="nav" data-section="nav">
  <div class="wrap">
    <a href="#top" class="brand">THORN <span>/ 98</span></a>
    <div class="nav-links">
      <a href="#controls">Controls</a><a href="#display">Display</a><a href="#finish">Finish</a><a href="#specs">Specs</a>
    </div>
    <div class="nav-right">
      <button class="snd" id="snd" aria-pressed="true" aria-label="Control sounds">
        <svg class="on" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M4 9.5h3.5L12 5.5v13l-4.5-4H4z"/><path d="M15.5 9a4.2 4.2 0 0 1 0 6M18 6.5a7.6 7.6 0 0 1 0 11"/></svg>
        <svg class="off" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M4 9.5h3.5L12 5.5v13l-4.5-4H4z"/><path d="m16 9.5 5 5M21 9.5l-5 5"/></svg>
      </button>
      <a class="btn" href="#reserve"><span class="dot"></span>Reserve</a>
    </div>
  </div>
</nav>

<header class="hero" id="top" data-section="hero">
  <div class="beam"></div>
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="hero-top">
      <div class="reveal">
        <div class="kicker">THORN / 98 — Master Controller</div>
        <h1>Music you can put your <em>hands</em> on.</h1>
      </div>
      <div class="hero-side reveal" style="transition-delay:.12s">
        <p class="lede">Two detented dials, twin faders, a joystick and three tape keys, arranged around one quiet screen. Every function has a place your hand can find without looking.</p>
        <div class="ctas">
          <a class="btn" href="#reserve"><span class="dot"></span>Reserve — $649</a>
          <a class="link" href="#controls">Explore the controls <span aria-hidden="true">↓</span></a>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="stage dev-in" id="heroStage">
      <div class="scene" data-rx="-12" data-ry="-17" data-amp="10" data-intro="1" style="--p:2800px"><div class="device rig dev-hero" data-c="device" data-hint="1"></div></div>
    </div>
    <div class="readout reveal">
      <div class="ro">
        <span class="st"><i></i><b data-bind="status">STANDBY</b></span>
        <span>VOL <b data-bind="vol">35</b></span>
        <span>FM <b data-bind="fm">98.0</b></span>
        <span>LOW <b data-bind="d0">+0</b></span>
        <span>HIGH <b data-bind="d1">+0</b></span>
      </div>
      <div class="finish-pick">FINISH
        <div class="sw" role="group" aria-label="Finish">
          <button data-finish-set="fog" data-finish="fog" aria-label="Fog" aria-pressed="true"></button>
          <button data-finish-set="graphite" data-finish="graphite" aria-label="Graphite" aria-pressed="false"></button>
          <button data-finish-set="sand" data-finish="sand" aria-label="Sand" aria-pressed="false"></button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</header>

<section class="controls sec" id="controls" data-section="controls">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="sec-head">
      <div class="reveal"><div class="kicker">01 — Controls</div><h2>All hardware.<br>Zero menus.</h2></div>
      <p class="lede reveal">THORN/98 puts its settings on the front panel. Each control does one thing and does it the same way every time. Everything below is live, so go ahead and turn it.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="bento">
      <article class="tile wide reveal">
        <div class="t-val">LOW <b data-bind="d0">+0</b> &nbsp;·&nbsp; HIGH <b data-bind="d1">+0</b></div>
        <div class="t-stage"><div class="scene" data-rx="0" data-ry="0" data-amp="0" style="--p:1100px"><div class="kit rig k-dials" data-c="dials"></div></div></div>
        <div class="t-copy"><span class="n">01</span><h3>Detent dials</h3><p>Two 80-step dials with a 320° sweep. The left shapes the low end and the right shapes the top. Each step has a click you can feel.</p></div>
      </article>
      <article class="tile reveal" style="transition-delay:.08s">
        <div class="t-val">VOL <b data-bind="vol">35</b></div>
        <div class="t-stage"><div class="scene" data-rx="0" data-ry="0" data-amp="0" style="--p:900px"><div class="kit rig k-faders" data-c="faders"></div></div></div>
        <div class="t-copy"><span class="n">02</span><h3>Long-throw faders</h3><p>Volume and tuner. The tuner covers the full FM band, 87.5 to 108 MHz.</p></div>
      </article>
      <article class="tile reveal">
        <div class="t-val">MODE <b data-bind="mode">PLAYER</b></div>
        <div class="t-stage"><div class="scene" data-rx="0" data-ry="0" data-amp="0" style="--p:800px"><div class="kit rig k-joy" data-c="joy"></div></div></div>
        <div class="t-copy"><span class="n">03</span><h3>Joystick</h3><p>Push left or right to move between Player, Radio and Tape. Tap it to play or pause.</p></div>
      </article>
      <article class="tile reveal" style="transition-delay:.08s">
        <div class="t-val"><b data-bind="tapeStat">STOPPED</b></div>
        <div class="t-stage"><div class="scene" data-rx="0" data-ry="0" data-amp="0" style="--p:900px"><div class="kit rig k-keys" data-c="keys"></div></div></div>
        <div class="t-copy"><span class="n">04</span><h3>Tape keys</h3><p>Stop, play, record. Play and record latch down like a cassette deck, so the key position tells you the machine's state.</p></div>
      </article>
      <article class="tile reveal" style="transition-delay:.16s">
        <div class="glow-led"></div>
        <div class="t-val"><b data-bind="status">STANDBY</b></div>
        <div class="t-stage"><div class="scene" data-rx="0" data-ry="0" data-amp="0" style="--p:700px"><div class="kit rig k-power" data-c="power"></div></div></div>
        <div class="t-copy"><span class="n">05</span><h3>One lit key</h3><p>The power key is the only light on the panel. Lime means on.</p></div>
      </article>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<section class="display sec" id="display" data-section="display">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="sec-head">
      <div class="reveal"><div class="kicker">02 — Display</div><h2>A screen that speaks only when spoken to.</h2></div>
      <p class="lede reveal">A matte panel set deep in the bezel. It shows what you just changed, then gets out of the way. No feeds, no badges, no notifications.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="disp-grid">
      <div class="scene reveal" data-rx="-7" data-ry="8" data-amp="8" style="--p:2400px"><div class="kit rig k-screen" data-c="screen"></div></div>
      <div class="reveal" style="transition-delay:.1s">
        <div class="queue" id="queue"><h4>Up next</h4></div>
        <div class="disp-power"><div class="scene" data-rx="-30" style="--p:500px"><div class="kit rig" data-c="power"></div></div><span>POWER</span></div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <dl class="facts reveal">
      <div><dt>Three modes</dt><dd>Player, Radio and Tape. The joystick or the arrows beside the mode label switch between them.</dd></div>
      <div><dt>Ambient glow</dt><dd>A soft lime wash breathes behind the glass during playback and turns orange while recording.</dd></div>
      <div><dt>Side toggles</dt><dd>Two lever switches on the right flank set shuffle and repeat. They work blind.</dd></div>
    </dl>
  </div>
</section>

<section class="finish sec" id="finish" data-section="finish">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="sec-head">
      <div class="reveal"><div class="kicker">03 — Material</div><h2>One alloy.<br>Three finishes.</h2></div>
      <p class="lede reveal">A bead-blasted aluminium shell with soft-touch controls. Two accent colours carry meaning across every finish: lime for power, signal orange for record.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="fin-cards">
      <div role="button" tabindex="0" class="fin reveal" data-finish-set="fog" aria-pressed="true">
        <div class="mini"><div class="scene" data-rx="-12" data-ry="-22" data-amp="6" style="--p:1400px"><div class="device rig" data-c="device" data-finish="fog"></div></div></div>
        <div class="row"><h3>Fog</h3><span class="chip" data-finish="fog"></span></div>
        <p>The original. Cool grey with graphite faders.</p><div class="hex">#C9CED3 · #51575D</div>
      </div>
      <div role="button" tabindex="0" class="fin reveal" data-finish-set="graphite" aria-pressed="false" style="transition-delay:.08s">
        <div class="mini"><div class="scene" data-rx="-12" data-ry="-22" data-amp="6" style="--p:1400px"><div class="device rig" data-c="device" data-finish="graphite"></div></div></div>
        <div class="row"><h3>Graphite</h3><span class="chip" data-finish="graphite"></span></div>
        <p>Dark anodised shell with fog-grey faders.</p><div class="hex">#51575D · #C9CED3</div>
      </div>
      <div role="button" tabindex="0" class="fin reveal" data-finish-set="sand" aria-pressed="false" style="transition-delay:.16s">
        <div class="mini"><div class="scene" data-rx="-12" data-ry="-22" data-amp="6" style="--p:1400px"><div class="device rig" data-c="device" data-finish="sand"></div></div></div>
        <div class="row"><h3>Sand</h3><span class="chip" data-finish="sand"></span></div>
        <p>Warm off-white with umber faders.</p><div class="hex">#DAD4C9 · #4C463E</div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="accents reveal">
      <div class="acc lim"><span>POWER</span><div><b>Lime</b><small>#7BB470 → #A9D046</small></div></div>
      <div class="acc sig"><span>RECORD</span><div><b>Signal</b><small>#FE5D01</small></div></div>
      <div class="acc car"><span>DISPLAY</span><div><b>Carbon</b><small>#0F1215</small></div></div>
      <div class="acc typ"><span>TYPE</span><div><div class="big">Saira</div><small>Labels and display, with Asap for text</small></div></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<section class="specs sec" id="specs" data-section="specs">
  <div class="wrap spec-grid">
    <div class="reveal spec-side"><div class="kicker">04 — Specifications</div><h2 style="margin-top:18px">The details.</h2><div class="spec-dev"><div class="scene" data-rx="-9" data-ry="-32" data-amp="8" style="--p:1800px"><div class="device rig" data-c="device"></div></div></div><p class="spec-cap">Shown in <b data-bind="finishName">Fog</b>. Change the finish in the hero or the Material section.</p></div>
    <dl class="spec-list reveal">
      <div><dt>Dimensions</dt><dd>325 × 163 × 58 mm</dd></div>
      <div><dt>Weight</dt><dd>1.9 kg</dd></div>
      <div><dt>Display</dt><dd>4.2″ matte panel, recessed bezel</dd></div>
      <div><dt>Controls</dt><dd>2 detent dials (80 steps, 320°), 2 long-throw faders, 4-way joystick, 3 latching tape keys, 2 side toggles</dd></div>
      <div><dt>Audio</dt><dd>2 × 20 W, front-firing full-range driver behind a 46-hole grille</dd></div>
      <div><dt>Radio</dt><dd>FM 87.5–108 MHz</dd></div>
      <div><dt>Connectivity</dt><dd>Wi-Fi, Bluetooth 5.3, USB-C, 3.5 mm line out</dd></div>
      <div><dt>Finishes</dt><dd>Fog, Graphite, Sand</dd></div>
    </dl>
  </div>
</section>

<section class="final" id="reserve" data-section="cta">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="kicker reveal" style="justify-content:center">Reservations</div>
    <h2 class="reveal" style="margin-top:18px">Turn it on.</h2>
    <p class="lede reveal">THORN/98 is $649. A refundable reservation holds your place in the first production run.</p>
    <div class="scene reveal" data-rx="0" data-ry="0" data-amp="0" style="--p:900px"><div class="kit rig k-power" data-c="power"></div></div>
    <div class="ctas reveal">
      <button class="btn" id="reserveBtn"><span class="dot"></span>Reserve THORN/98</button>
      <a class="link" href="#specs">Full specifications</a>
    </div>
    <p class="note reveal">FOG · GRAPHITE · SAND</p>
  </div>
</section>

<footer data-section="footer"><div class="wrap"><span class="brand" style="font-size:15px">THORN <span>/ 98</span></span><span>Designed around the hand. A fictional product made for a template demo.</span></div></footer>
<div class="toast" id="toast"><i></i><span></span></div>

<script>
(()=>{
/* ───────── state (mirrors the Rive state machine "MasterPlayer_Animator") ───────── */
const TR=[{t:'Khobs',a:'Issam Hajali',d:252},{t:'SHUM',a:'Go_A',d:180},{t:'Namesake',a:'Noname',d:218}];
const MODES=['PLAYER','RADIO','TAPE'];
const S={power:false,playing:false,track:2,prog:[0,0,0.02],shuffle:false,loop:false,rec:false,mode:0,
  dial:[0,0],fader:[0.35,0.512],tape:0,sound:true};
const H=document.documentElement;
const $$=(s,r=document)=>[...r.querySelectorAll(s)];

/* ───────── icons ───────── */
const I={
 prev:'<svg viewBox="0 0 12 12"><path d="M1.6 1.2h1.8v9.6H1.6zM10.6 1.4v9.2L4 6z" fill="currentColor"/></svg>',
 next:'<svg viewBox="0 0 12 12"><path d="M8.6 1.2h1.8v9.6H8.6zM1.4 1.4v9.2L8 6z" fill="currentColor"/></svg>',
 play:'<svg class="i-play" viewBox="0 0 10 10"><path d="M2.2 1v8l6.6-4z" fill="currentColor"/></svg>',
 stop:'<svg class="i-stop" viewBox="0 0 10 10"><rect x="1.6" y="1.6" width="6.8" height="6.8" rx=".6" fill="currentColor"/></svg>',
 shuf:'<svg viewBox="0 0 12 12" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M1 3.2h2.2c2.6 0 3.2 5.6 5.8 5.6H11M1 8.8h2.2c1 0 1.6-.8 2.1-1.8M6.7 5c.5-1 1.1-1.8 2.3-1.8H11M9.6 1.8 11 3.2 9.6 4.6M9.6 7.4 11 8.8l-1.4 1.4"/></svg>',
 loop:'<svg viewBox="0 0 12 12" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M2.4 5.2V4.6c0-.9.7-1.6 1.6-1.6h6M8.6 1.6 10 3 8.6 4.4M9.6 6.8v.6c0 .9-.7 1.6-1.6 1.6H2M3.4 10.4 2 9l1.4-1.4"/></svg>',
 power:'<svg viewBox="0 0 12 12" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.3" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M6 1.2v4.4"/><path d="M3.3 3a4.1 4.1 0 1 0 5.4 0"/></svg>',
 l:'<svg viewBox="0 0 5 8"><path d="M4.4.4v7.2L.2 4z" fill="currentColor"/></svg>',
 r:'<svg viewBox="0 0 5 8"><path d="M.6.4v7.2L4.8 4z" fill="currentColor"/></svg>',
 reel:'<svg viewBox="0 0 40 40"><circle cx="20" cy="20" r="18.5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.2"/><circle cx="20" cy="20" r="5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.2"/><g stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.2"><path d="M20 15V3M24.3 22.5l10.4 6M15.7 22.5l-10.4 6"/></g></svg>'
};

/* ───────── component builders (all geometry in Rive design units) ───────── */
// dial label positions measured from the rendered artboard, relative to dial centre
// labels every 40° on r≈72, ticks offset by 20° on r≈70 (from the artboard)
const pol=(deg,r)=>[r*Math.sin(deg*Math.PI/180),-r*Math.cos(deg*Math.PI/180)];
const LBL=[...Array(9)].map((_,k)=>pol(k*40,75.5));
const TCK=[...Array(9)].map((_,k)=>pol(-20+k*40,70.5));
// 3D helpers: a layer at depth z, and a stack of n layers from z0 to z1 (extrusion)
const Ly=(c,z,st='')=>`<i class="ly ${c}" style="transform:translateZ(${(+z).toFixed(2)}em);${st}"></i>`;
const stack=(c,z0,z1,n,st='')=>{let h='';for(let k=0;k<n;k++)h+=Ly(c+(k===0?' sh':''),z0+(z1-z0)*k/(n-1),st);return h};
const at=(x,y)=>x!=null?`style="left:${x}em;top:${y}em"`:'';
const dial=(i,x,y)=>{
  let h=`<div class="dial" ${x!=null?`style="left:${x-90}em;top:${y-90}em"`:''}>`;
  TCK.forEach(([dx,dy])=>{const a=Math.atan2(dy,dx)*180/Math.PI+90;h+=`<i class="d-tick" style="left:${90+dx}em;top:${90+dy}em;transform:rotate(${a}deg)"></i>`});
  LBL.forEach(([dx,dy],k)=>h+=`<span class="d-lbl" data-l="${k*10}" style="left:calc(${90+dx}*var(--u));top:calc(${90+dy}*var(--u))">${k*10}</span>`);
  h+=stack('d-fl',0,1.6,2)+Ly('d-fl t',2.4);
  h+=`<div class="d-knob" data-dial="${i}" role="slider" tabindex="0" aria-label="${i?'High':'Low'} dial" aria-valuemin="0" aria-valuemax="80" aria-valuenow="0">`;
  h+=stack('d-wall k',2.6,20.6,13)+Ly('d-top',21.2);
  h+=`<div class="d-rot">${stack('g-wall',.2,10.4,8)}${Ly('g-top',11.2)}</div></div></div>`;
  return h;
};
const fader=(i,x,y)=>`<div class="fader" ${x!=null?`style="left:${x-22}em;top:${y}em"`:''}>${stack('f-house',0,2,2)}${Ly('f-house t',3)}${Ly('f-slot',3.2)}
  <div class="f-thumb" data-thumb="${i}">${stack('t-wall',3.4,16,9)}${Ly('t-top',16.8)}</div>
  <div class="f-hit" data-fader="${i}" role="slider" tabindex="0" aria-label="${i?'Tuner':'Volume'}" aria-valuemin="0" aria-valuemax="100" style="transform:translateZ(3.3em)"></div><div class="f-lbl">${i?'TUNER':'VOLUME'}</div></div>`;
const dome=()=>{let h=stack('j-neck',0,4,4);const n=12;
  for(let k=0;k<n;k++){const t=k/(n-1),r=Math.max(2.5,17.6*Math.sqrt(1-t*t*.98)),z=4.6+t*13,p=Math.round(40+60*t);
    h+=Ly('j-dome',z,`left:${18-r}em;top:${18-r}em;width:${2*r}em;height:${2*r}em;background:radial-gradient(circle at 42% 36%,color-mix(in srgb,var(--nub1) ${p}%,#fff),color-mix(in srgb,var(--nub2) ${35+t*65}%,#000) 98%)`)}
  return h};
const joy=(x,y)=>`<div class="joy" ${x!=null?`style="left:${x-50}em;top:${y-50}em"`:''}><svg class="ticks" viewBox="0 0 100 100">
  <g stroke="var(--tick)" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round">${[45,90,135,180,225].map(a=>{const r=a*Math.PI/180;return `<line x1="${50+38*Math.cos(r)}" y1="${50+38*Math.sin(r)}" x2="${50+42*Math.cos(r)}" y2="${50+42*Math.sin(r)}"/>`}).join('')}</g>
  <g class="arc"><path d="M50 9.5A40.5 40.5 0 0 1 90.5 50" fill="none" stroke="var(--label-ink)" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" opacity=".75"/><line x1="88" y1="50" x2="93" y2="50" stroke="var(--label-ink)" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" opacity=".75"/></g></svg>
  ${stack('j-base',0,6,5)}${Ly('j-plate',7)}
  <div class="j-lift"><div class="j-nub" data-joy role="button" tabindex="0" aria-label="Joystick: press to play or pause, push left or right to change mode">${dome()}</div></div></div>`;
const key=(k,n,lbl)=>`<button class="key k-${k}" data-key="${k}" aria-label="${lbl}" style="top:${n*44.05}em">${stack('k-wall',0,6.6,5)}<span class="k-face"><i></i></span></button>`;
const keys=(x,y)=>`<div class="keys" ${at(x,y)}>${key('stop',0,'Stop')}${key('play',1,'Play')}${key('rec',2,'Record')}</div>`;
const power=(x,y,pulse)=>`<div class="power" ${at(x,y)}><button class="pw ${pulse?'pulse':''}" data-power-btn aria-label="Power" aria-pressed="false">${stack('pw-ring',0,2.8,3)}${Ly('pw-rtop',3.4)}<span class="core">${I.power}</span></button></div>`;
const SLEEP=`<div class="s-sleep"><div class="sl-mark">THORN <span>/ 98</span></div><button class="sl-badge" data-power-btn aria-label="Turn on THORN/98" aria-pressed="false"><span class="sl-ico">${I.power}</span><span class="sl-txt">PRESS TO POWER ON</span></button><div class="sl-sub"><i></i><span>STANDBY</span></div></div>`;
const screen=(x,y,sleep)=>`<div class="scr3" ${at(x,y)}>${Ly('bz sh',0)}${Ly('bz',.9)}${Ly('bz t',1.8)}<div class="screen" style="left:0;top:0;transform:translateZ(2.3em)"><div class="glow"></div>${sleep?SLEEP:''}<div class="sui">
  <div class="s-mode"><button data-modestep="-1" aria-label="Previous mode">${I.l}</button><span class="lbl" data-bind="mode">PLAYER</span><button data-modestep="1" aria-label="Next mode">${I.r}</button></div>
  <div class="s-toast"></div><div class="s-flags"><span class="f-shuf">SHUF</span><span class="f-loop">RPT</span></div>
  <div class="pg pg-0"><div class="s-title" data-bind="title">Namesake</div><div class="s-artist" data-bind="artist">Noname</div>
    <div class="s-bar" data-seek><i></i><b></b></div>
    <div class="s-ctl"><button class="sm b-shuf" style="left:92em" data-act="shuffle" aria-label="Shuffle">${I.shuf}</button>
    <button style="left:122em" data-act="prev" aria-label="Previous">${I.prev}</button>
    <button class="pp" style="left:157.5em" data-act="toggle" aria-label="Play or stop">${I.play}${I.stop}</button>
    <button style="left:193em" data-act="next" aria-label="Next">${I.next}</button>
    <button class="sm b-loop" style="left:223em" data-act="loop" aria-label="Repeat">${I.loop}</button></div></div>
  <div class="pg pg-1"><div class="r-freq"><span data-bind="fm">98.0</span><small>MHz</small></div><div class="r-sub">FM · STEREO</div>
    <div class="r-scale"></div><div class="r-scale2"></div><div class="r-needle"></div>
    <div class="r-lbls"><span>88</span><span>92</span><span>96</span><span>100</span><span>104</span><span>108</span></div></div>
  <div class="pg pg-2"><div class="t-side">SIDE A</div><div class="t-count" data-bind="count">0000</div><div class="t-stat" data-bind="tapeStat">STOPPED</div>
    <div class="reel" style="left:62em;top:30em">${I.reel}</div><div class="reel" style="left:253em;top:30em">${I.reel}</div></div>
  </div></div></div>`;
const tippy=(k,y,lbl)=>`<button class="tippy" data-tippy="${k}" style="top:${y}em" aria-label="${lbl}" aria-pressed="false">${stack('tp-l',-34,-16,7)}${Ly('tp-f',-15)}</button>`;
const device=(hint)=>{
  let h='';
  h+='<div class="face f-back"></div><div class="face f-bot"></div><div class="face f-left"></div>';
  h+='<div class="face f-top"><i class="vent"></i><i class="seam"></i></div>';
  h+='<div class="face f-right"><i class="seam"></i><i class="port usb"></i><i class="port jack"></i><span class="port-lbl" style="left:calc(28*var(--u))">USB-C</span><span class="port-lbl" style="left:calc(58*var(--u))">LINE</span></div>';
  h+='<div class="shell"><div class="plate"><i class="sheen"></i><i class="deck"></i>';
  // speaker grille: 3 staggered rows, light end-holes
  [[26.5,23,15],[23,30.5,16],[26.5,38,15]].forEach(([x0,y,n])=>{for(let k=0;k<n;k++)h+=`<i class="hole${k==0||k==n-1?' e':''}" style="left:${x0+k*7.15}em;top:${y}em"></i>`});
  h+='</div><div class="badge">THORN <span>/ 98</span></div>';
  h+='<span class="engr" style="left:calc(33*var(--u));top:calc(140*var(--u))">MASTER CONTROLLER</span><span class="engr" style="left:calc(380*var(--u));top:calc(305*var(--u))">DESIGNED FOR THE HAND · MODEL 98</span>';
  h+='<i class="ln h" style="left:0;top:162em;width:651em"></i><i class="ln v" style="left:324em;top:163em;height:162em"></i><i class="ln v" style="left:587.5em;top:163em;height:131em"></i><i class="ln h" style="left:325em;top:294em;width:326em"></i><i class="ln v" style="left:365em;top:295em;height:30em"></i>';
  h+=screen(327,10);
  h+=dial(0,80,244.75)+dial(1,242.5,244.75);
  h+=fader(0,375,191)+fader(1,435,191);
  h+=joy(525,228.5);
  h+=keys(588,163);
  h+=power(325,295,hint);
  if(hint)h+='<div class="hint">PRESS <b>POWER</b> TO BEGIN</div>';
  h+='</div>';
  h+=tippy('shuffle',42,'Shuffle toggle')+tippy('loop',108,'Repeat toggle');
  h+=`<div class="foot3" style="left:70em">${stack('ft',-26,-10,4)}${Ly('ft t',-9)}</div><div class="foot3" style="left:561em">${stack('ft',-26,-10,4)}${Ly('ft t',-9)}</div>`;
  return h;
};
$$('[data-c=device]').forEach(el=>{el.innerHTML=device(el.dataset.hint);const sc=el.closest('.scene');if(sc&&!sc.querySelector('.gshadow'))sc.insertAdjacentHTML('afterbegin','<i class="gshadow"></i>')});
$$('[data-c=dials]').forEach(el=>el.innerHTML=dial(0)+dial(1));
$$('[data-c=faders]').forEach(el=>el.innerHTML=fader(0)+fader(1));
$$('[data-c=joy]').forEach(el=>el.innerHTML=joy());
$$('[data-c=keys]').forEach(el=>el.innerHTML=keys());
$$('[data-c=power]').forEach(el=>el.innerHTML=power());
$$('[data-c=screen]').forEach(el=>el.innerHTML=screen(null,null,true));
// mini devices in finish cards are decorative
$$('.fin [tabindex],.fin button:not(.fin)').forEach(e=>{e.tabIndex=-1;e.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true')});
$$('.fin .device').forEach(d=>d.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true'));
const q=document.getElementById('queue');
TR.forEach((t,i)=>{const b=document.createElement('button');b.className='q';b.dataset.track=i;
  b.innerHTML=`<span class="i">0${i+1}</span><span><span class="tt">${t.t}</span><span class="aa">${t.a}</span></span><span class="eq"><span></span><span></span><span></span></span>`;q.appendChild(b)});

/* ───────── sound: tiny synthesized mechanical clicks ───────── */
let AC;
function click(f=3200,g=.18,len=.018){
  if(!S.sound)return;
  try{AC=AC||new (window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)();
    const n=AC.sampleRate*len|0,buf=AC.createBuffer(1,n,AC.sampleRate),d=buf.getChannelData(0);
    for(let i=0;i<n;i++)d[i]=(Math.random()*2-1)*Math.pow(1-i/n,4);
    const s=AC.createBufferSource(),bp=AC.createBiquadFilter(),gn=AC.createGain();
    bp.type='bandpass';bp.frequency.value=f;bp.Q.value=1.2;gn.gain.value=g;
    s.buffer=buf;s.connect(bp).connect(gn).connect(AC.destination);s.start();
  }catch(e){}
}
const thunk=()=>{click(900,.35,.05);setTimeout(()=>click(2400,.12,.015),35)};

/* ───────── render ───────── */
const fmt=s=>`${Math.floor(s/60)}:${String(Math.floor(s%60)).padStart(2,'0')}`;
const fm=()=>(87.5+S.fader[1]*20.5).toFixed(1);
const vol=()=>Math.round(S.fader[0]*100);
const sgn=v=>v===0?'+0':`+${v}`;
let toastT=0;
function stoast(txt){$$('.s-toast').forEach(t=>{t.textContent=txt;t.classList.add('show')});clearTimeout(toastT);toastT=setTimeout(()=>$$('.s-toast').forEach(t=>t.classList.remove('show')),1300)}
function tapeStat(){return !S.power?'STANDBY':S.rec?'● RECORDING':S.playing?'▶ PLAYING':'■ STOPPED'}
function bind(k,v){$$(`[data-bind=${k}]`).forEach(e=>{if(e.textContent!==v)e.textContent=v})}
function render(){
  H.dataset.power=S.power?'on':'off';H.dataset.playing=S.playing?1:0;H.dataset.rec=S.rec?1:0;
  H.dataset.mode=S.mode;H.dataset.shuffle=S.shuffle?1:0;H.dataset.loop=S.loop?1:0;
  const t=TR[S.track];
  bind('title',t.t);bind('artist',t.a);bind('mode',MODES[S.mode]);bind('fm',fm());bind('vol',String(vol()));
  bind('d0',sgn(S.dial[0]));bind('d1',sgn(S.dial[1]));bind('tapeStat',tapeStat());
  bind('status',!S.power?'STANDBY':S.rec?'RECORDING':S.playing?'PLAYING':'READY');
  bind('count',String(Math.floor(S.tape)).padStart(4,'0'));
  S.dial.forEach((v,i)=>{$$(`[data-dial="${i}"]`).forEach(f=>{f.querySelector('.d-rot').style.setProperty('--a',v*4+'deg');f.setAttribute('aria-valuenow',v);
    f.closest('.dial').querySelectorAll('.d-lbl').forEach(l=>l.classList.toggle('hit',+l.dataset.l===v&&S.power))})});
  S.fader.forEach((v,i)=>{$$(`[data-thumb="${i}"]`).forEach(th=>th.style.top=(6+(1-v)*35)+'em');
    $$(`[data-fader="${i}"]`).forEach(f=>{f.setAttribute('aria-valuenow',Math.round(v*100));f.setAttribute('aria-valuetext',i?fm()+' MHz':vol()+'%')})});
  $$('.key').forEach(k=>k.classList.toggle('down',(k.dataset.key==='play'&&S.playing&&S.power)||(k.dataset.key==='rec'&&S.rec&&S.power)||k.classList.contains('mom')));
  $$('[data-power-btn]').forEach(b=>b.setAttribute('aria-pressed',S.power));
  $$('[data-tippy]').forEach(b=>b.setAttribute('aria-pressed',S[b.dataset.tippy]));
  $$('.q').forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('cur',+b.dataset.track===S.track));
  frame();
}
function frame(){
  const p=S.prog[S.track],t=TR[S.track];
  $$('.s-bar').forEach(b=>{b.firstChild.style.width=(p*100)+'%';b.children[1].style.left=(p*100)+'%'});
  $$('.r-needle').forEach(n=>n.style.left=(46+S.fader[1]*223)+'em');
  $$('.reel svg').forEach(r=>r.style.transform=`rotate(${S.tape*40}deg)`);
  bind('count',String(Math.floor(S.tape)).padStart(4,'0'));
}

/* ───────── actions ───────── */
function setPower(on){S.power=on;if(!on){S.playing=false;S.rec=false}else{stoast('HELLO')}thunk();render()}
function needPower(){if(!S.power){$$('[data-power-btn]').forEach(b=>{b.animate([{transform:'scale(1)'},{transform:'scale(1.15)'},{transform:'scale(1)'}],{duration:420})});return true}}
function swapTrack(n){
  $$('.pg-0').forEach(p=>p.classList.add('swap'));
  setTimeout(()=>{S.track=n;S.prog[n]=0;render();$$('.pg-0').forEach(p=>p.classList.remove('swap'))},180);
}
function nextTrack(dir=1){let n=S.shuffle?(S.track+1+Math.floor(Math.random()*(TR.length-1)))%TR.length:(S.track+dir+TR.length)%TR.length;swapTrack(n)}
function setMode(step){S.mode=(S.mode+step+MODES.length)%MODES.length;click(2600,.15);render()}
function act(a){
  if(needPower())return;
  click(2800,.14);
  if(a==='toggle'){S.playing=!S.playing;if(!S.playing)S.rec=false}
  if(a==='prev'){if(S.prog[S.track]>.08)S.prog[S.track]=0;else nextTrack(-1)}
  if(a==='next')nextTrack(1);
  if(a==='shuffle'){S.shuffle=!S.shuffle;stoast(S.shuffle?'SHUFFLE ON':'SHUFFLE OFF')}
  if(a==='loop'){S.loop=!S.loop;stoast(S.loop?'REPEAT ON':'REPEAT OFF')}
  render();
}
function keyPress(k,el){
  thunk();
  if(k==='stop'){el.classList.add('mom');setTimeout(()=>{el.classList.remove('mom');render()},180)}
  if(needPower()){if(k!=='stop'){el.classList.add('mom');setTimeout(()=>{el.classList.remove('mom');render()},180)}render();return}
  if(k==='stop'){S.playing=false;S.rec=false;S.prog[S.track]=0}
  if(k==='play'){S.playing=true}
  if(k==='rec'){S.rec=!S.rec;if(S.rec){S.playing=true;S.mode=2}}
  render();
}

/* ───────── input ───────── */
document.addEventListener('click',e=>{
  const t=e.target.closest('[data-power-btn],[data-act],[data-modestep],[data-key],[data-tippy],[data-finish-set],.q,[data-seek]');
  if(!t)return;
  if(t.matches('[data-power-btn]'))return setPower(!S.power);
  if(t.matches('[data-act]'))return act(t.dataset.act);
  if(t.matches('[data-modestep]')){if(needPower())return;return setMode(+t.dataset.modestep)}
  if(t.matches('[data-key]'))return keyPress(t.dataset.key,t);
  if(t.matches('[data-tippy]')){click(1500,.3,.03);const k=t.dataset.tippy;S[k]=!S[k];if(S.power)stoast(k==='shuffle'?(S.shuffle?'SHUFFLE ON':'SHUFFLE OFF'):(S.loop?'REPEAT ON':'REPEAT OFF'));return render()}
  if(t.matches('[data-finish-set]')){const f=t.dataset.finishSet;H.dataset.finish=f;bind('finishName',f[0].toUpperCase()+f.slice(1));$$('[data-finish-set]').forEach(b=>b.setAttribute('aria-pressed',b.dataset.finishSet===f));click(2000,.12);return}
  if(t.matches('.q')){if(!S.power)setPower(true);S.mode=0;S.playing=true;swapTrack(+t.dataset.track);return}
  if(t.matches('[data-seek]')){if(needPower())return;const r=t.getBoundingClientRect();S.prog[S.track]=Math.min(1,Math.max(0,(e.clientX-r.left)/r.width));click(2800,.1);render()}
});
// dials
function dialFromPoint(el,x,y){
  const r=el.getBoundingClientRect(),cx=r.left+r.width/2,cy=r.top+r.height/2;
  let a=Math.atan2(x-cx,-(y-cy))*180/Math.PI;if(a<0)a+=360;
  return a<=320?Math.round(a/4):(a<340?80:0);
}
function setDial(i,v,soft){
  v=Math.max(0,Math.min(80,v));if(v===S.dial[i])return;
  const old=S.dial[i];S.dial[i]=v;
  click(v%10===0?2200:3600,v%10===0?.22:.09,.012);
  if(S.power)stoast(`${i?'HIGH':'LOW'} ${sgn(v)}`);render();
}
// faders
function setFader(i,v){
  v=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,v));const before=i?fm():vol();S.fader[i]=v;
