  const after=i?fm():vol();if(before!==after){if(!i&&after%5===0)click(4200,.05,.008);if(S.power)stoast(i?`FM ${after}`:`VOL ${after}`)}
  render();
}
let drag=null;
document.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{
  const d=e.target.closest('[data-dial]'),f=e.target.closest('[data-fader]'),j=e.target.closest('[data-joy]');
  if(!d&&!f&&!j)return;
  e.preventDefault();
  if(d){const i=+d.dataset.dial;const start=dialFromPoint(d,e.clientX,e.clientY);drag={type:'d',el:d,i,last:S.dial[i],off:start-S.dial[i]}}
  if(f){const i=+f.dataset.fader;const th=f.parentNode.querySelector('.f-slot').getBoundingClientRect();drag={type:'f',el:f,i,top:th.top,h:th.height}}
  if(j){drag={type:'j',el:j,x:e.clientX,y:e.clientY,dx:0,dy:0};j.classList.add('drag')}
  (d||f||j).setPointerCapture?.(e.pointerId);
});
document.addEventListener('pointermove',e=>{
  if(!drag)return;
  if(drag.type==='d'){
    let v=dialFromPoint(drag.el,e.clientX,e.clientY);
    if(Math.abs(v-drag.last)>40)return; // ignore wrap-around jumps
    drag.last=v;setDial(drag.i,v);
  }
  if(drag.type==='f'){const v=1-(e.clientY-drag.top-drag.h*.1)/(drag.h*.8);setFader(drag.i,v)}
  if(drag.type==='j'){
    const r=drag.el.getBoundingClientRect(),unit=r.width/36;let dx=(e.clientX-drag.x)/unit,dy=(e.clientY-drag.y)/unit;
    const m=Math.hypot(dx,dy),max=9;if(m>max){dx*=max/m;dy*=max/m}
    drag.dx=dx;drag.dy=dy;drag.el.style.transform=`translate(${dx}em,${dy}em)`;
    const arc=drag.el.closest('.joy').querySelector('.arc');if(m>2)arc.style.transform=`rotate(${Math.atan2(dy,dx)*180/Math.PI+45}deg)`;
  }
});
function endDrag(){
  if(!drag)return;
  if(drag.type==='j'){
    const {dx,dy,el}=drag;el.classList.remove('drag');el.style.transform='';
    const arc=el.closest('.joy').querySelector('.arc');arc.style.transform='';
    if(Math.hypot(dx,dy)<3){act('toggle')}
    else if(Math.abs(dx)>Math.abs(dy)){if(!needPower())setMode(dx>0?1:-1)}
    else if(!needPower()){setFader(0,S.fader[0]+(dy<0?.1:-.1));click(3000,.1)}
  }
  drag=null;
}
document.addEventListener('pointerup',endDrag);document.addEventListener('pointercancel',endDrag);
// keyboard
document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{
  const d=e.target.closest?.('[data-dial]'),f=e.target.closest?.('[data-fader]'),j=e.target.closest?.('[data-joy]');
  const step={ArrowUp:1,ArrowRight:1,ArrowDown:-1,ArrowLeft:-1,PageUp:10,PageDown:-10}[e.key];
  if(d&&step){e.preventDefault();setDial(+d.dataset.dial,S.dial[+d.dataset.dial]+step)}
  if(f&&step){e.preventDefault();setFader(+f.dataset.fader,S.fader[+f.dataset.fader]+step*.01)}
  if(j){if(e.key==='Enter'||e.key===' '){e.preventDefault();act('toggle')}if(e.key==='ArrowLeft'||e.key==='ArrowRight'){e.preventDefault();if(!needPower())setMode(e.key==='ArrowRight'?1:-1)}}
});
document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{const f=e.target.closest?.('.fin');if(f&&(e.key==='Enter'||e.key===' ')){e.preventDefault();f.click()}});
document.getElementById('snd').addEventListener('click',e=>{S.sound=!S.sound;e.currentTarget.setAttribute('aria-pressed',S.sound);click(2400,.15)});
const toast=document.getElementById('toast');
document.getElementById('reserveBtn').addEventListener('click',()=>{thunk();if(!S.power)setPower(true);toast.querySelector('span').textContent='Reservations open soon. This button is a placeholder.';toast.classList.add('show');setTimeout(()=>toast.classList.remove('show'),3200)});

/* ───────── loop ───────── */
let last=performance.now();
function loop(now){
  const dt=Math.min(.1,(now-last)/1000);last=now;
  if(S.power&&S.playing){
    S.prog[S.track]+=dt/TR[S.track].d;S.tape+=dt*(S.rec?1.6:1.2);
    if(S.prog[S.track]>=1){if(S.loop)S.prog[S.track]=0;else{S.prog[S.track]=0;nextTrack(1)}}
    frame();
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
requestAnimationFrame(loop);

/* ───────── 3D: cursor-follow tilt, specular sheen, intro turn ───────── */
const RM=matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
const SC=$$('.scene').map(sc=>({sc,bx:+sc.dataset.rx||0,by:+sc.dataset.ry||0,amp:RM?0:+(sc.dataset.amp||0),tx:0,ty:0,cx:0,cy:0,intro:sc.dataset.intro&&!RM?1:0,vis:false}));
const vio=new IntersectionObserver(es=>es.forEach(en=>{const s=SC.find(o=>o.sc===en.target);if(s)s.vis=en.isIntersecting}),{rootMargin:'100px'});
SC.forEach(s=>vio.observe(s.sc));
let px=innerWidth/2,py=innerHeight/2;
addEventListener('pointermove',e=>{if(e.pointerType==='touch')return;px=e.clientX;py=e.clientY},{passive:true});
function tilt(){
  for(const s of SC){
    if(!s.vis&&!s.intro&&s.init)continue;s.init=1;
    if(!drag){const r=s.sc.getBoundingClientRect();
      s.tx=Math.max(-1,Math.min(1,(px-(r.left+r.width/2))/(innerWidth*.5)));
      s.ty=Math.max(-1,Math.min(1,(py-(r.top+r.height/2))/(innerHeight*.6)));}
    s.cx+=(s.tx-s.cx)*.06;s.cy+=(s.ty-s.cy)*.06;
    if(s.intro&&s.vis)s.intro*=.955;if(s.intro<.002)s.intro=0;
    const rx=s.bx-s.cy*s.amp*.55-s.intro*18,ry=s.by+s.cx*s.amp-s.intro*34;
    s.sc.style.setProperty('--rx',rx.toFixed(2)+'deg');s.sc.style.setProperty('--ry',ry.toFixed(2)+'deg');
    s.sc.style.setProperty('--gx',(55+s.cx*35+ry*.8).toFixed(1)+'%');s.sc.style.setProperty('--sx',(ry*1.4).toFixed(1));s.sc.style.setProperty('--gy',(18+s.cy*25).toFixed(1)+'%');
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(tilt);
}
requestAnimationFrame(tilt);

/* ───────── chrome ───────── */
const nav=document.getElementById('nav');
const onScroll=()=>nav.classList.toggle('scrolled',scrollY>20);addEventListener('scroll',onScroll,{passive:true});onScroll();
const io=new IntersectionObserver(es=>es.forEach(en=>{if(en.isIntersecting){en.target.classList.add('in');io.unobserve(en.target)}}),{threshold:.12,rootMargin:'0px 0px -40px 0px'});
$$('.reveal,.dev-in').forEach(el=>io.observe(el));
render();
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
